warehouses.sql: SELECT NNR_FILIAL filial,NNR_CODIGO code,NNR_DESCRI description FROM [dbo].[NNR010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND NNR_CODIGO IN ('10')

users.sql: SELECT USR_ID id,USR_CODIGO username,USR_NOME name FROM dbo.SYS_USR WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND (USR_CODIGO LIKE '%expedi%' OR USR_NOME LIKE '%rafaela%' OR USR_NOME LIKE '%tamara%' OR USR_NOME LIKE '%bruna%')

all_internal.sql: SELECT D3_LOCAL warehouse,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_ESTORNO reversed,COUNT_BIG(*) records,MIN(D3_EMISSAO) firstDate,MAX(D3_EMISSAO) latestDate FROM [dbo].[SD3010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL='04' AND D3_LOCAL IN ('10') GROUP BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM

recent_internal.sql: SELECT D3_LOCAL warehouse,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_USUARIO operator,D3_ESTORNO reversed,COUNT_BIG(*) records FROM [dbo].[SD3010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL='04' AND D3_LOCAL IN ('10') AND D3_EMISSAO BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_USUARIO,D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF

orders.sql: SELECT C2_LOCAL warehouse,CASE WHEN C2_DATRF='' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END status,COUNT_BIG(*) records,MIN(C2_EMISSAO) firstDate,MAX(C2_EMISSAO) latestDate FROM [dbo].[SC2010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND C2_FILIAL='04' AND C2_LOCAL IN ('10') GROUP BY C2_LOCAL,CASE WHEN C2_DATRF='' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END

stock.sql: SELECT B2_LOCAL warehouse,COUNT_BIG(*) products,SUM(CASE WHEN B2_QATU<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonzero FROM [dbo].[SB2010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND B2_FILIAL='04' AND B2_LOCAL IN ('10') GROUP BY B2_LOCAL

recent_transfers.sql: SELECT d.D3_LOCAL origin,p.D3_LOCAL destination,COUNT_BIG(*) pairs FROM [dbo].[SD3010] d JOIN [dbo].[SD3010] p ON p.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND p.D3_FILIAL=d.D3_FILIAL AND p.D3_DOC=d.D3_DOC AND p.D3_NUMSEQ=d.D3_NUMSEQ AND p.D3_EMISSAO=d.D3_EMISSAO AND p.D3_ESTORNO=d.D3_ESTORNO AND p.D3_CF='DE4' WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D3_FILIAL='04' AND d.D3_CF='RE4' AND d.D3_NUMSEQ<>'' AND d.D3_ESTORNO<>'S' AND d.D3_EMISSAO BETWEEN ? AND ? AND (d.D3_LOCAL IN ('10') OR p.D3_LOCAL IN ('10')) GROUP BY d.D3_LOCAL,p.D3_LOCAL ORDER BY origin,destination

recent_SD1.sql: SELECT d.D1_LOCAL warehouse,d.D1_TES tes,d.D1_CF cfop,f.F4_TEXTO description,f.F4_ESTOQUE stock,COUNT_BIG(*) items,MIN(d.D1_DTDIGIT) firstDate,MAX(d.D1_DTDIGIT) latestDate FROM [dbo].[SD1010] d OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) F4_TEXTO,F4_ESTOQUE FROM [dbo].[SF4010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND F4_CODIGO=d.D1_TES AND F4_FILIAL IN (d.D1_FILIAL,'') ORDER BY CASE WHEN F4_FILIAL=d.D1_FILIAL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,R_E_C_N_O_) f WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D1_FILIAL='04' AND d.D1_LOCAL IN ('10') AND d.D1_DTDIGIT BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY d.D1_LOCAL,d.D1_TES,d.D1_CF,f.F4_TEXTO,f.F4_ESTOQUE

recent_SD2.sql: SELECT d.D2_LOCAL warehouse,d.D2_TES tes,d.D2_CF cfop,f.F4_TEXTO description,f.F4_ESTOQUE stock,COUNT_BIG(*) items,MIN(d.D2_EMISSAO) firstDate,MAX(d.D2_EMISSAO) latestDate FROM [dbo].[SD2010] d OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) F4_TEXTO,F4_ESTOQUE FROM [dbo].[SF4010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND F4_CODIGO=d.D2_TES AND F4_FILIAL IN (d.D2_FILIAL,'') ORDER BY CASE WHEN F4_FILIAL=d.D2_FILIAL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,R_E_C_N_O_) f WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D2_FILIAL='04' AND d.D2_LOCAL IN ('10') AND d.D2_EMISSAO BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY d.D2_LOCAL,d.D2_TES,d.D2_CF,f.F4_TEXTO,f.F4_ESTOQUE

fiscal_schema.sql: SELECT t.name tableName,c.name columnName FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.name IN ('SD2010','SF2010') AND (c.name LIKE 'F2_%' OR c.name IN ('D2_PEDIDO','D2_ITEMPV','D2_TIPO')) ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

fiscal_all.sql: SELECT 'SD1' source,COUNT_BIG(*) items FROM [dbo].[SD1010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D1_FILIAL='04' AND D1_LOCAL='10' UNION ALL SELECT 'SD2',COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [dbo].[SD2010] WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D2_FILIAL='04' AND D2_LOCAL='10'

posting_order_warehouses.sql: SELECT c.C2_LOCAL orderWarehouse,COUNT_BIG(*) postings FROM [dbo].[SD3010] d LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SC2010] c ON c.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND c.C2_FILIAL=d.D3_FILIAL AND c.C2_NUM+c.C2_ITEM+c.C2_SEQUEN=d.D3_OP WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D3_FILIAL='04' AND d.D3_LOCAL='10' AND d.D3_CF='PR0' AND d.D3_ESTORNO<>'S' AND d.D3_EMISSAO BETWEEN '20260624' AND '20260924' GROUP BY c.C2_LOCAL

tracking_recent.sql: SELECT f.F2_RASTREI enabled,f.F2_TRASTRE trackingType,COUNT_BIG(*) notes,SUM(CASE WHEN f.F2_CODRAST<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) withTracking,SUM(CASE WHEN f.F2_LOGRAST<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) withLog,SUM(CASE WHEN f.F2_TRANSP<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) withCarrier FROM [dbo].[SF2010] f WHERE f.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND f.F2_FILIAL='04' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[SD2010] d WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D2_FILIAL=f.F2_FILIAL AND d.D2_DOC=f.F2_DOC AND d.D2_SERIE=f.F2_SERIE AND d.D2_CLIENTE=f.F2_CLIENTE AND d.D2_LOJA=f.F2_LOJA AND d.D2_TIPO=f.F2_TIPO AND d.D2_LOCAL='10') AND f.F2_EMISSAO BETWEEN '20260624' AND '20260924' GROUP BY f.F2_RASTREI,f.F2_TRASTRE

tracking_all.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) notes,SUM(CASE WHEN f.F2_CODRAST<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) withTracking,SUM(CASE WHEN f.F2_LOGRAST<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) withLog,MAX(f.F2_EMISSAO) latestDate FROM [dbo].[SF2010] f WHERE f.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND f.F2_FILIAL='04' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[SD2010] d WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D2_FILIAL=f.F2_FILIAL AND d.D2_DOC=f.F2_DOC AND d.D2_SERIE=f.F2_SERIE AND d.D2_CLIENTE=f.F2_CLIENTE AND d.D2_LOJA=f.F2_LOJA AND d.D2_TIPO=f.F2_TIPO AND d.D2_LOCAL='10')

fiscal_unique_headers.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) duplicateKeys FROM (SELECT f.F2_FILIAL,f.F2_DOC,f.F2_SERIE,f.F2_CLIENTE,f.F2_LOJA,f.F2_TIPO FROM [dbo].[SF2010] f WHERE f.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND f.F2_FILIAL='04' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[SD2010] d WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D2_FILIAL=f.F2_FILIAL AND d.D2_DOC=f.F2_DOC AND d.D2_SERIE=f.F2_SERIE AND d.D2_CLIENTE=f.F2_CLIENTE AND d.D2_LOJA=f.F2_LOJA AND d.D2_TIPO=f.F2_TIPO AND d.D2_LOCAL='10') GROUP BY f.F2_FILIAL,f.F2_DOC,f.F2_SERIE,f.F2_CLIENTE,f.F2_LOJA,f.F2_TIPO HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q
